data.long_meaning: Oyeniyi is a name of Yoruba origin from Nigeria, meaning 'God's gift'. It is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of the Yoruba people and reflects their deep reverence for the divine. The name Oyeniyi carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Oyeniyi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
